limits.notes: Read in a browser 2026-11-16: the formatting guide and the initial-submission page (https://www.nature.com/nature/for-authors/initial-submission). Title: 'Titles must fit on two lines in print (75 characters including spaces)'. Summary paragraph 'ideally of no more than 200 words'. A typical 6-page article: a main text of 2,500 words and 4 modest display items; a typical 8-page article: 4,300 words and 5–6 modest display items; up to 50 references as a guideline. Methods 'typically do not exceed 3,000 words'; 'Methods-only references do not count against your reference limit.' Legends: the initial-submission page says 'Figure legends of <250 words each', the formatting guide 'Legends should be fewer than 300 words each' (250 kept: the two pages differ). Up to ten Extended Data items. 'Word counts refer to the text of the paper. Title, author list, acknowledgements and references are not included'. Earlier (2026-11-13): the 2018 brief guide (https://www.nature.com/documents/nature_3a_initial_revised_submissions.pdf).
